title: UI Sources
description: A library of real-world user flows, screen interactions, and UI patterns captured from top-performing mobile and web applications to inspire product designers.

title: SimilarPNG
description: A repository providing transparent PNG images and cutout graphics ready to download for creative projects.

title: PNGWing
description: A vast database of transparent PNG stickers, transparent clipart, and isolated image assets.

title: Looka
description: An AI-powered logo maker and brand identity platform that generates custom logos and marketing assets based on your style preferences.

title: Remove.BG
description: An automated AI tool designed to instantly and cleanly remove image backgrounds in a matter of seconds.

title: Unscreen
description: A utility that allows users to remove the background from videos, GIFs, and animations automatically without manual green-screen editing.

title: Pixabay
description: A popular platform offering royalty-free stock photos, illustrations, vector graphics, and video footage.

title: Colorsinspo
description: A comprehensive hub for color inspiration featuring hand-picked color palettes, gradients, and tools to aid color selection.

title: Mobbin
description: The world’s largest UI and UX reference library, allowing designers to discover real-world mobile and web app screens sorted by app, component, or pattern.

title: Muzli Colors
description: An intuitive color palette generator and exploration tool that lets you test colors instantly on real-world UI mockups.

title: Cleanup.pictures
description: An AI-powered inpainting and cleanup tool used to instantly erase unwanted objects, defects, or people from photos.
